tools.name: get_analysis_exchange
tools.title: Get analysis exchange status
tools.description: Get participation, current terms, enabled frameworks and this workspace's published or legacy-held submissions. Terms: https://app.outsidechair.com/terms#8-analysis-exchange

tools.name: get_analysis_brief
tools.title: Get an analysis brief
tools.description: Read the generated framework contract and synthetic examples before preparing an analysis. Optional lookup returns groups of one division or countries of one region.

division.description: NACE division code from get_analysis_brief; preserve leading zeroes.

tools.name: validate_analysis
tools.title: Validate a sanitised analysis
tools.description: Validate without storing the analysis. Input must already be sanitised; include attestations {sanitised:true, sharingRights:true}. Checks do not verify facts or confidentiality.

tools.name: publish_analysis
tools.title: Publish an analysis
tools.description: Publish immediately under standing workspace authorisation accepted at https://app.outsidechair.com/terms#8-analysis-exchange, with attestations {sanitised:true, sharingRights:true}. Delivered copies cannot be recalled. Report the exact stored subject, conclusion and withdrawal action.

tools.name: withdraw_analysis
tools.title: Withdraw an analysis
tools.description: Withdraw a workspace-owned analysis from future distribution, or cancel a legacy held version. Already delivered copies cannot be recalled. Current-term acceptance is not required for withdrawal.

tools.name: retrieve_analyses
tools.title: Retrieve relevant analyses
tools.description: Retrieve up to five relevant active analyses, or use explicit re_review mode for limited analyses. Current Exchange terms at https://app.outsidechair.com/terms#8-analysis-exchange, an enabled framework and NACE division are required.

industry_code.description: NACE division code from get_analysis_brief; preserve leading zeroes.

scope.description: global, a region from the brief, or a country code from get_analysis_brief lookup.region.

tools.name: get_exchange_analysis
tools.title: Read an exchange analysis
tools.description: Read a version authored by or already delivered to this workspace. An eligible Owner, Admin or Member can receive one newer released correction; Viewers retain delivered reads without triggering delivery.

tools.name: rate_analysis
tools.title: Rate a delivered analysis
tools.description: Append or revise feedback on a released analysis delivered to this workspace under the current terms at https://app.outsidechair.com/terms#8-analysis-exchange. Factual challenges require counter-evidence or an exact unsupported statement.

tools.name: get_workspace_team
tools.title: Get workspace team
tools.description: Read the active members, roles, member count and your team permissions. Invitation email addresses are returned only to Owner or Admin.

tools.name: invite_workspace_member
tools.title: Invite a workspace member
tools.description: Create a single-use 14-day invitation link after explicit confirmation. The returned link contains a secret and may be shared only with the invited email address.

tools.name: get_team_context
tools.title: Get team deliberation context
tools.description: Read attributed human viewpoints and governed resolutions. Separate these stored contributions from the current agent's interpretation.

tools.name: open_deliberation
tools.title: Open a team deliberation
tools.description: Open a structured question, optionally pinned to one exact strategy record version, only after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: record_viewpoint
tools.title: Record a team viewpoint
tools.description: Record an attributed support, challenge, alternative or question with exact evidence references after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: withdraw_viewpoint
tools.title: Withdraw a team viewpoint
tools.description: Withdraw an immutable viewpoint after explicit confirmation; corrections are recorded as a new viewpoint.

tools.name: prepare_deliberation_resolution
tools.title: Prepare a deliberation resolution
tools.description: Owner or Admin prepares an immutable 30-minute resolution proposal whose hash includes every current non-withdrawn viewpoint.

tools.name: confirm_deliberation_resolution
tools.title: Confirm a deliberation resolution
tools.description: Owner or Admin commits the exact displayed resolution proposal after explicit confirmation. It does not change strategy records.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get connected Outside Chair profile
tools.description: Read connection, permissions, current account entitlements and owned-workspace allowance. Use for setup or account-access questions; no subscription offers or transactions.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List private strategy workspaces
tools.description: List every accessible workspace and its canonical Outside Chair control-page URL. Always use the returned URL; never derive one.

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.title: Create a private strategy workspace
tools.description: Create a self-declared company or project workspace only after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: rename_workspace
tools.title: Rename a workspace
tools.description: Rename an active workspace after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: archive_workspace
tools.title: Archive a workspace
tools.description: Make a workspace read-only while preserving its governed history.

tools.name: restore_workspace
tools.title: Restore a workspace
tools.description: Restore a previously archived workspace.

tools.name: get_strategy_context
tools.title: Get current strategy context
tools.description: Retrieve current versioned strategy records, accepted evidence, relationships, decision outcomes and recent approved reviews.

tools.name: get_attention_queue
tools.title: Get strategy attention queue
tools.description: Return deterministic high, medium and informational items requiring attention. It never infers that a free-text signpost threshold was crossed.

tools.name: save_strategy_records
tools.title: Save confirmed strategy records
tools.description: Save a baseline or append updates after confirmation of the complete proposal. Both modes append immutable records or versions with optimistic concurrency. Link by batch index or unchanged recordVersionId.

payload.description: Record payload. Required fields depend on type and are validated by the server's strict type-specific schema.

items.description: Use exactly one fromRecordIndex or fromRecordVersionId, and one toRecordIndex or toRecordVersionId.

tools.name: archive_strategy_record
tools.title: Archive a strategy record
tools.description: Archive one current strategy record after explicit confirmation while preserving its history and approved reviews.

tools.name: submit_evidence_cards
tools.title: Submit approved evidence cards
tools.description: Store user-approved claims and interpretations against exact record versions. Outside Chair neither fetches nor verifies the source location.

tools.name: prepare_review
tools.title: Prepare a strategy review
tools.description: Compare current governed context with the latest or selected approved strategy review and return deterministic changes, actions, outcomes and attention items without writing.

tools.name: prepare_review_approval
tools.title: Prepare exact review approval
tools.description: Store an immutable review proposal for 30 minutes and return the exact summary and hash that must be shown to the user before approval.

tools.name: approve_review
tools.title: Approve a prepared strategy review
tools.description: Commit the exact unexpired review proposal only after the user confirms its displayed summary and hash.

tools.name: get_approved_review
tools.title: Get an approved strategy review
tools.description: Retrieve exact frozen records, evidence, relationships, decisions and actions. Omit reviewId for the latest approved snapshot.

tools.name: prepare_decision_confirmation
tools.title: Prepare exact decision confirmation
tools.description: Store an immutable decision, selected context and actions for 30 minutes and return the exact summary and hash that must be shown before confirmation.

tools.name: confirm_decision
tools.title: Confirm a prepared decision
tools.description: Freeze context and commit the exact unexpired decision proposal after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: update_action
tools.title: Update a follow-up action
tools.description: Record the confirmed status and completion details for one action using optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: record_decision_outcome
tools.title: Record a decision outcome assessment
tools.description: Create or revise an immutable assessment of what happened after an exact decision, optionally considering exact observations and attaching current accepted evidence cards.

tools.name: export_workspace
tools.title: Export complete workspace
tools.description: Return the complete authorized workspace export, including version history, reviews, audit metadata and decision outcomes.
